_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro: O jẹ Player {player_id} ni Awọn ẹrọ orin mẹta Tic Tac Toe. aami rẹ ni '{symbol}'. O gba ni iyipada fifi aami rẹ sori igbimọ 5x5 lati ṣe ila ti mẹrin. Awọn ila le jẹ onigun, inaro, tabi diagonal. Fi igbiyanju rẹ silẹ nipa lilo ọna kika '[4] lati samisi sẹẹli 4.

board.current_board: Àwòrán: {board} Àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ tí ó wà: {moves}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Àdàkọ ìyípòpò tí kò bá tọ́. Lo "[cell]" níbi tí sẹẹli jẹ́ 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nọmba sẹẹli ti ko wulo: {cell}. O gbọdọ wa laarin 0 ati {max_cell}.
invalid_move.made_invalid: Ẹ̀yà eré {player_id} ṣe ìgbésẹ̀ tí kò lẹ́sẹ̀ nílẹ̀

game_action.placed: Ẹ̀yin olùdíje {player_id} fi àmì ({symbol}) sí àlàfo ({row}, {col}).

outcome.win: Ẹnìkan tí ó ń jẹ́ {player_id} ({symbol}) ló borí!
